dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Rampal Upazila Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 4 June 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240502BGD, GDACS ID: 1001064** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures as observed by using a Pléiades satellite image acquired on 4 June 2024 at 10:31 Local Time. Within the analysis extent, UNOSAT identified 30 damaged structures and 270 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
